dcterms:description: The UCR time series classification archive is composed of 108 smaller datasets, where each dataset contains univariate time-series data. The FordA dataset, for example, contains measurements of engine noise over time and the goal is to classify whether or not the car is faulty.
dcterms:title: UCR Time Series Classification Archive

dcterms:description: The Mapillary Traffic Sign Dataset (MTSD) is used for the detection and classification of traffic signs in images. The dataset consists of images containing traffic signs, selected to focus on single signs for improved localization and classification.
dcterms:title: Mapillary Traffic Sign Dataset

dcterms:description: Rotated MNIST is a modified version of the MNIST dataset where images are rotated by a certain angle, providing ground-truth transformations for testing localization and classification models.
dcterms:title: Rotated MNIST

dcterms:description: Random Placement Fashion MNIST is a variant of the Fashion MNIST dataset where images are randomly placed on a black background, allowing for testing of localization and classification models under different conditions.
dcterms:title: Random Placement Fashion MNIST
